decision: Replace the failed first Romance tranche with an ultra-reasoning redo while preserving the failed tranche as evidence.

Delete the failed tranche and lose its diagnostic evidence
Restart the whole lane without a continuation cursor

The failed output contained grammatical defects including la elemento and invariant-article failures
The user explicitly required a frontier-model redo that continues production
motivation: Preserve diagnostic history while moving the real objective forward under the required reasoning setting.
uncertainty_and_adverse_evidence: A stronger model does not itself prove linguistic quality; every successor still requires source, semantic, and render checks.
consequences: All accepted current production and gates live under the redo root; earlier material remains historical evidence only.
reflection: This solved the false-completion and provenance-reset problem. It did not supply human validation or finish any of the four stages. Later evidence can supersede individual redo artifacts but not erase the failed-tranche record.
revisit_when: Only if a later authoritative recovery proves the redo omitted valid prior evidence or used a wrong source authority.
public_claim_boundary: The redo is active production, not a completed or certified Romance edition.

decision: Adopt nine reader cohorts as the canonical Romance access topology.
selected_option: Separate Rumantsch Grischun readers from readers of regional Romansh idioms, yielding nine cohorts.
alternatives_considered: Retain the older eight-cohort manager tree
Merge all Romansh readers into one cohort
Add unbounded micro-cohorts without a stable topology
evidence_used: The live access ledger already distinguished Rumantsch Grischun and regional-idiom readers
The manager v1 tree silently merged them and caused a control-plane split
ROMANCE_FAMILY_COHORT_TREE_v2 has exactly nine leaf IDs and zero human observations
motivation: Make marginal-access rows reproducible and prevent one dominant Romansh standard from standing in for idiom readers.
uncertainty_and_adverse_evidence: The cohort partition is a protocol design, not empirical proof that these groups behave uniformly.
consequences: The access surface is fixed at 106 senses × 9 cohorts = 954 rows until a versioned human-protocol change.
reflection: This repaired a topology contradiction. It did not create human observations or validate the cohort boundaries empirically. Human study design may later refine the topology through a new version.
revisit_when: A documented human-study protocol shows that a cohort must be split, merged, or differently recruited.
public_claim_boundary: Nine cohorts describe the sampling topology only; they do not establish intelligibility.

decision: Quarantine Romansh automatic-search placeholders and nonmathematical pages from active/counting corpus coverage.

uncertainty_and_adverse_evidence: The rejection proves those downloads are unusable, not that no suitable Romansh body exists elsewhere.
consequences: Rejected rows contribute zero source-manifest bytes and zero downloaded/active coverage; the gap remains explicit.
reflection: This removed a false eight-language coverage claim. It did not solve Romansh acquisition. Later genuine bodies can close specific routes without rehabilitating these rejected pages.
revisit_when: Never for the rejected bytes themselves; only a newly verified source may change coverage.

decision: Admit four official 2025 Romansh mathematics examination bodies as general mathematics evidence but not as specialist abstract-algebra evidence.

Use the Rumantsch Grischun body as a proxy for missing idioms

Each body has reviewed variety, extracted text, hashes, HTTP metadata, pdfinfo, and sampled renders
The content is admission-level mathematics rather than ring/field/module theory
motivation: Improve genuine branch coverage without inflating domain depth or collapsing varieties.
uncertainty_and_adverse_evidence: Rights remain unresolved and the material is translated/parallel educational content; it is not native specialist research prose.
consequences: General Romansh mathematics coverage is active for four varieties, while specialist Romansh algebra, Surmiran, and Sutsilvan remain zero-body.
reflection: This replaced the earlier zero-body state with honest but narrow evidence. It did not supply advanced algebra vocabulary or independent idiom corpora for every branch.
revisit_when: A provenance-backed specialist body or a rights determination changes the relevant route classification.
public_claim_boundary: Four general mathematics bodies do not establish substantive specialist-algebra coverage for Romansh.

decision: Split the overloaded domain and identity concepts into exact mathematical senses before bridge decisions.
selected_option: Represent T51 as function domain, integral domain, generic domain, and coefficient-domain linkage; represent T60 as identity element, identity map, algebraic identity, and unit/invertible-element senses.
alternatives_considered: Keep one sense per concept and one bridge decision
Treat coefficient domain as an untyped synonym of every domain sense
Merge neutral element, identity map, equation identity, and invertible unit
evidence_used: Recovered semantic audit explicitly required the T51 and T60 splits
Source uses showed distinct grammatical frames and mathematical entailments
False-sense mappings would otherwise create incorrect bridge evidence
motivation: Make attestation evidence sense-aware rather than canonizing homographs.
uncertainty_and_adverse_evidence: Historical terminology can overlap across sources; some occurrences remain held until context is sufficient.
consequences: WordWeb and access decisions are generated per sense; evidence cannot silently cross these boundaries.
reflection: The split stopped two high-risk homograph collapses. It did not guarantee that every remaining concept is perfectly granular; later evidence may justify additional versioned splits.
revisit_when: Exact source contexts reveal a materially distinct sense not represented by the current nodes.
public_claim_boundary: Sense topology is a curated semantic model, not proof that any bridge form is understood by readers.

decision: Report relation records separately from graph edges.

reflection: This fixed a misleading metric. It also exposes that relation coverage is still thin, which is useful rather than embarrassing. Future graph expansion must add valid targets, not merely more descriptive records.

public_claim_boundary: 406 relation records must never be advertised as 406 graph edges.

revisit_when: A versioned study supplies auditable cohort-level observations and consent/analysis metadata.

decision: Use invariant singular demonstrative iste in the T008 referential construction and reject lexical plural istes.

consequences: T008 validator requires iste es contenite, rejects lexical istes, and narrows slash-bundle checks to lexical cases.
reflection: The repair made T008 internally consistent and reproducible. It did not prove that invariant iste is optimal across Romance cohorts; future human evidence may motivate a versioned grammar change.
revisit_when: Cross-tranche grammar evidence or human review shows the invariant rule creates a larger access or ambiguity cost.
public_claim_boundary: The rule is a source-keyed construction decision, not a native-language correctness claim.

decision: Make meticulous decision logging a permanent, validator-bound Romance lane requirement.
selected_option: Maintain an append-only JSONL ledger with evidence, alternatives, motivation, uncertainty, consequences, review state, revisit conditions, and retrospective reflection for every material decision.
alternatives_considered: Rely on chat commentary
Record only final choices without alternatives or reflection
Keep separate unvalidated prose notes per tranche
evidence_used: Floris explicitly required the same durable decision-log discipline as the core lane
Current build and gate logs preserve commands but do not uniformly preserve motivations and reflections
The lane already contains corrections whose rationale would be lost if only final artifacts remained
motivation: Make the intellectual and editorial process inspectable, correctable, and transferable across sessions.
uncertainty_and_adverse_evidence: A schema cannot guarantee honest judgment; entries still require substantive review and may need correction.
consequences: Future manager controls and successor gates must hash and semantically validate the rule, ledger, validator, and report; corrections append rather than overwrite history.
reflection: This converts an interaction-level instruction into durable project governance and backfills the decisions that produced the live state. It does not validate the decisions by itself and must be maintained continuously rather than treated as a one-time documentation exercise.
revisit_when: Only to version and strengthen the schema; never to remove the requirement for motivation and reflection.
public_claim_boundary: The ledger documents decisions and uncertainty; it is not a scientific validation certificate.

decision: Carry the FABLE linguistic review into the live T001–T009 successor and make living multi-branch attestation a structural function-word test.
selected_option: Revise dona→da, acta→opera, dunque→per consequente, nam→perque where causal, et etiam→e in plus or restructure, sur→sobre for onto phrasing, vector-riga→vector-linea, and dummy illo→null subject or se; retain ora, per causa del, in tal caso, assi, nos, contractions, and the documented su/lor and tote/toto splits; hold invariant le and ubi as explicit unresolved alternatives rather than silently promoting them.
alternatives_considered: Keep the current Latin/Interlingua-shaped function layer as anti-Spanish/French rotation
Normalize the whole text to Spanish or French
Adopt every FABLE suggestion without checking source scope or live corpus attestation
Ignore the review because its six-tranche counts are historical
evidence_used: FABLE_RESPONSE_T005_PROFILE_V5_FOR_ROMANCE_REVIEW_20260718.md gives per-form supporting/adverse evidence and false-friend analysis

Spanish dona/donar creates a donation false friend; Spanish/ Catalan acta is a minutes/document noun; Spanish sur means south; riga is Italian-only; nam, et etiam, and illo lack living multi-branch support
Null subjects are shared across ES/IT/PT/CA/RO, and proposed replacements have identified living anchors in at least two branches
The live lane has eight accepted tranches, so revisions must be applied to T001–T008 successors and T009 rather than to the older six-tranche profile only
motivation: Prevent anti-ES/FR rotation from collapsing into a dead Latin/Interlingua pivot and remove concrete cross-cohort false parses while preserving source meaning.
uncertainty_and_adverse_evidence: The review supplies expert parse-risk judgments, not human cohort observations; per consequente, da, opera, sobre, and vector-linea still need corpus-row admission evidence and later human testing. Ubi has no clean pan replacement and invariant le has competing number/gender risks.
consequences: T009 must not introduce the rejected forms; T001–T008 require versioned correction and rebuild; the cumulative function ledger must record living branch anchors and dominance penalties; no old PDF is overwritten without a preserved v11 snapshot.
reflection: The rule addresses the function-layer failure that noun rotation alone could not solve. It does not prove the replacements intelligible or optimal, and it deliberately keeps le and ubi unresolved until stronger evidence exists.
revisit_when: Source-specific syntax blocks a replacement, corpus attestation fails the two-living-branch threshold, adverse evidence emerges, or named-cohort human observations justify a different form.
public_claim_boundary: These are source-informed construction revisions and parse-risk predictions, not native validation, promotion, or empirical intelligibility findings.

decision: Freeze the exact 500-file v11 acceptance surface before applying cross-tranche FABLE linguistic corrections.

decision: Publish a metadata-complete but quote- and path-free projection of WordWeb/access v11 as the first bounded public semantic checkpoint.
selected_option: Retain all 60 concepts, 106 senses, 39 extension nodes, 811 evidence-metadata records, 106 provisional decisions, 406 relation records, nine cohorts, 954 access rows, and the 28-sense gap cursor, while excluding raw source bodies, quotations, locators, host paths, and C2 context snippets; bind the projection to the four internal v11 input hashes and require deterministic rebuild plus an independent public-safety validator.
alternatives_considered: Publish the raw internal WordWeb with quotations and host paths
Publish only a flat 60-word vocabulary without evidence metadata or sense decisions
Withhold all semantic work until source-body rights and human testing are complete
Treat all 406 relation records as graph edges
Waive the first 32/33 validation result because the missing explicit phrase did not change row data
evidence_used: Internal WordWeb SHA 570822B02B2C713429C097CA526B87ACE39C2441A1DEB1B937E79FBA18303E26 and access JSON/CSV hashes 2EB86526…/463E6624… are stable v11 inputs
The raw WordWeb contains 1,105 locator fields, 1,104 quote fields, 404 form source locators, 39 C2 context arrays, and host paths that are unsuitable for direct publication
The public successor passed 33/33 semantic, topology, grid, claim-boundary, input-binding, and path/quote-exclusion checks
Two isolated builds and the live build matched byte-for-byte; the 13-row manifest independently recomputed 13/13 and the deterministic ZIP replay matched at SHA 55D64DDF…
motivation: Make the substantive WordWeb and cohort ledger inspectable now without redistributing rights-unresolved source text or leaking workstation paths, while preserving enough metadata and adverse evidence to avoid turning attestation into canon.
uncertainty_and_adverse_evidence: Metadata-only publication prevents readers from independently inspecting the underlying quotations until rights or controlled access are resolved. Orthographic proxies remain nonhuman diagnostics, 28 senses remain unsupported, the 120 inherited ES/FR core records retain zero quotations, and no package license is assigned here.
consequences: The archive task receives the public_v1 directory and deterministic ZIP; the earlier 32/33 directory is preserved and explicitly marked failed. This checkpoint does not replace the internal provenance authority, v11 acceptance gate, or ongoing Stage D production.
reflection: The failed first build was useful: an explicit zero-human statement belongs in the method, not only in machine fields. Preserving that failed draft and rebuilding into a successor keeps the assurance history honest. The public projection is intentionally less evidentially rich than the internal authority, but materially more useful and auditable than a vocabulary-only release. It does not expose the underlying quotations or resolve their rights status.
revisit_when: Underlying source rights are clarified, a controlled quotation-access layer is approved, human cohort data exist, the WordWeb advances semantically, or the archive maintainer selects a package license and release topology.
public_claim_boundary: This is not source-rights, intelligibility, controlled-language-completion, or lane-completion certification; it is a deterministic public-safe semantic/access checkpoint with zero human observations, zero pilot eligibility, and zero form promotions.

work_unit: Rumantsch Grischun curriculum intake to corpus-v6/routing-v5 integration
continuation_cursor: RDL-0018: one accepted deduplicated rm-rg school-algebra body; abstract algebra, research prose, idiom proxying, term promotion, and human data remain zero.
